blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Image editors built on diffusion transformers (DiTs), such as Flux Kontext, make it possible to turn a single photograph into a convincing manipulated image, including harmful and non-consensual edits. Proactive defenses aim to prevent such manipulations by adding an imperceptible perturbation before an image is shared. Existing defenses for DiT-based in-context editors make the output attend less to the protected reference image. But this leaves the model free to follow the edit instruction using the text and its own generated tokens, often producing a new, weakly grounded image rather than preventing the edit. We find that the opposite strategy is more effective: instead of leading the model to ignore the reference, we encourage it to copy it. Through controlled attention interventions, we show that concentrating target-token attention on the reference image in only a few early blocks is sufficient to collapse the editing behavior, causing the model to reproduce its input, often as a lossy copy, rather than execute the requested transformation. Based on this insight, we introduce Copying-as-Defense (CaD), which maximizes per-token target-to-reference attention mass in early transformer blocks. Since attention rows are normalized, increasing reference attention suppresses the attention allocated to the text and generated canvas. Restricting the objective to early blocks also lets us truncate the backpropagation path, keeping optimization cheap. Across editors and benchmarks, CaD reduces average edit success from 81.4% on unprotected images to 24.0%, a 70.6% relative reduction, and by a further 44.3% relative to DeContext, the strongest baseline (43.0%). CaD is also roughly 1.8-2.0x faster per optimization step than comparable methods.
blocks.zh: 在扩散变压器(DiTs)上所建的图像编辑器,如Flux Kontext,使得将一幅相片变成令人信服地被操纵的相片成为可能,包括有害和未经同意的编辑. 主动防御的目的在于防止这种操纵,在分享一幅图像之前增加一种难以察觉的扰动. 基于 DiT 的内文编辑器的现有防御使得输出较少关注被保护的参考图像. 但是这让模型可以自由地使用文本和它自己生成的符号来遵循编辑指令,经常产生一个新的,被弱地固定的图像,而不是阻止编辑. 我们认为,相反的战略是更有效的:我们不但没有引导模型忽略参考,反而鼓励它复制。 通过受控的注意力干预,我们显示,仅仅在几个早期的块中集中目标对参考图像的注意力,就足以使编辑行为崩溃,导致模型复制其输入,往往是作为失落的复制,而不是执行所请求的转换. 基于这种洞察力,我们引入了Copy-as-Defense (CaD),它使早期变压器块中每个托克目标到参考的注意力质量最大化. 由于关注行的常态化,越来越多的引用关注会抑制对文本和生成的画布的注意. 将目标限制在早期的区块上,也让我们缩短了后向传播路径,保持最便宜的优化. 在编辑和基准方面,CaD将平均编辑成功率从无保护图像的81.4%降至24.0%,相对减少70.6%,与最强基线DeContext相比,减少44.3%(43.0%)。 CaD的每个优化步骤大约也快于可比方法.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A photograph posted online can now be transformed into a convincing manipulated image with a single natural-language instruction. The same capability that enables benign editing also lowers the barrier to harmful uses, including non-consensual sexualized imagery, impersonation, misinformation, fraud, and copyright misuse ( Li et al., 2026 ; NBC News, 2026 ; Marchal et al., 2024 ) . One response has been to protect an image before it is shared by adding a small, imperceptible perturbation designed to make downstream edits fail. This idea predates modern diffusion editors, with work disrupting GAN-based facial manipulation systems ( Ruiz et al., 2020 ) , and has since expanded to diffusion-based editing ( Salman et al., 2023 ; Choi et al., 2025 ) , unauthorized personalization Marchal et al. (2024) , and artistic imitation ( Liang et al., 2023 ; Shan et al., 2023 ; Hönig et al., 2025 ) . As generative architectures evolve, however, the mechanism a defense must disrupt evolves with them.
blocks.zh: 在网上张贴的照片现在可以用单一的自然语言教学,转化为令人信服的被操纵的图像. 同样能够进行良性编辑的能力也降低了有害用途的障碍,包括未经同意的性化图像、假冒、错误信息、欺诈和滥用版权(Li等人,2026年;NBC新闻,2026年;Marchal等人,2024年)。 一种反应是在分享图像之前保护图像,增加一个小的,不易察觉的扰动,旨在让下游编辑失败. 这一想法早于现代传播编辑,作品干扰了基于GAN的面部操纵系统(Ruiz等人,2020年),之后又扩展到基于传播的编辑(Salman等人,2023年;Choi等人,2025年),未经授权的个人化Marchal等人(2024年),以及艺术模仿(梁等人,2023年;Shan等人,2023年;Hönig等人,2025年). 然而,随着基因结构的演化,一个防御机制必须随其演化而中断。

blocks.en: That shift is especially important for the latest generation of diffusion transformers (DiTs) ( Peebles & Xie, 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Ma et al., 2024 ) . A DiT replaces the convolutional U-Net backbone with a transformer operating on latent patches ( Peebles & Xie, 2023 ) . Multimodal DiTs (MMDiT), introduced with Stable Diffusion 3, instead use separate weights for text and image tokens and let information flow in both directions between them ( Esser et al., 2024 ) . Models such as Flux Kontext and FIBO Edit mix such double-stream blocks, which keep modality-specific weights and mix tokens through attention over their concatenation, with single-stream blocks that subsequently process the concatenated sequence ( Black Forest Labs, 2025 ; Gutflaish et al., 2025 ) . Editors built on this design condition on a reference image by concatenating its tokens with the noisy output canvas along the sequence dimension. For adversarial protection, this architectural change matters twice because the representation we want to disrupt has changed, and backpropagating through a multi-billion-parameter editor is expensive.
blocks.zh: 这一转变对最新一代的传播变压器(DiTs)(Peebles & Xie,2023年;Chen等人,2024年;Ma等人,2024年)尤为重要。 一个DiT用一个在潜在补丁上运行的变压器(Peebles & Xie, 2023)来取代转动的U-Net主干线. Multimodate DiTs(MMDIT),由Stable Difusion 3推出,而是对文本和图像符号使用单独的权重,并让信息在它们之间的两个方向流动(Esser等人, 2024年). Flux Kontext和FIBO Edit等模型混合了这样的双流块,这些双流块通过注意其凝聚度来保持特定模式的权重和混合令牌,单流块随后处理凝聚序列(Black Forest Labs,2025;Gutflaish et al.,2025). 编辑器以这个设计条件为基础,在参考图像上,通过沿序列维度用吵闹的输出画布来调色其符号. 对于对抗性保护来说,这种建筑改变有两次重要,因为我们想要破坏的表述方式已经改变,通过数十亿参数的编辑器进行反宣传是昂贵的.

blocks.en: Recent work therefore attacks the mechanism through which an in-context editor reads its reference. DeContext ( Shen et al., 2025 ) suppresses target-to-reference attention, aiming to decontextualize generation. The intuition is that if the output cannot attend to the protected image, then it cannot edit it. But should protection actually make the editor forget the reference?
blocks.zh: 因此,最近的工作攻击了文本编辑员阅读其参考文献的机制。 DeContext(Shen等人,2025年)压制了靶向参考的注意,旨在解密生成. 直觉是,如果输出不能关注受保护的图像,那么它就不能编辑. 但保护真的应该让编辑忘记参考吗?

blocks.en: We find that reference suppression is not only insufficient, but can be counterproductive. Each softmax attention row sums to one, so reducing attention to reference tokens reallocates probability mass to the text instruction and the evolving target canvas, which are precisely the pathways that support instruction following and generation. A successfully “decontextualized” editor can therefore still satisfy a malicious prompt by generating content that is less grounded in the protected input. Moreover, recent interpretability work on FLUX.2 shows that text tokens absorb reference content within the first few blocks and carry it to the output even when the reference is removed from the computation afterwards ( Ge et al., 2026 ) . Suppression applied after this point therefore cannot remove what has already been absorbed, so a conservative defense should avoid this residual leakage altogether rather than attenuate it downstream. This failure is particularly visible for edits the model can plausibly generate without relying on the image at all ( i.e. , ones with strong generative prior). It also fails on full-body photographs, where the person, and especially sensitive identity such as the face, occupies only a small fraction of the reference tokens.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,禁止提及不仅不足,而且可能产生反效果。 每一个软最大注意力排为一,因此降低对参考符的注意力,将概率质量重新分配给文本指令和不断发展的目标画布,这些正是支持后续和生成指令的路径. 因此,一个成功的“解密”编辑器仍然能够通过生成较少基于受保护输入的内容来满足恶意提示。 此外,最近关于FLUX.2的可解释性工作显示,文本符号吸收了前几个区块内的参考内容,并携带到产出中,即使后来从计算中删除了参考(Ge等人,2026年)。 因此,在此点之后实施的禁止措施不能消除已经吸收的,因此,保守的防御应完全避免这种残余的渗漏,而不是减轻下游的渗漏。 这种失败对于编辑模型可以完全不依赖图像(即先有强烈基因的图像)而合理生成特别明显. 它还在全身照片上失败,在照片中,人物,尤其是像面部这样的敏感身份只占据了参考标志的一小部分.

blocks.en: We therefore invert the objective. Rather than optimizing a perturbation that causes the editor to use the protected image less , we ask what happens if it is forced to use the image more . Our controlled interventions on Flux Kontext reveal that forcing target queries to place their attention on reference keys in only a few early double-stream blocks causes the model to reproduce the reference rather than execute the edit. Conversely, explicitly removing reference attention does not prevent generation. Even with a black reference image, the same qualitative distinction exists, i.e. , forcing target ⇒ \Rightarrow reference attention yields the black input itself, whereas suppressing that attention still lets the model generate a new image. An output we want is therefore not forgetting, but copying .
blocks.zh: 因此,我们颠倒了目标。 我们不但没有优化导致编辑减少使用受保护图像的扰动, 我们在Flux Kontext的受控干预显示,迫使目标查询将其注意力放在仅几个早期双流块的引用键上,导致模型复制引用而不是执行编辑. 相反,明确删除参考注意并不妨碍生成。 即使有黑色的参考图像,也存在同样的质的区别,即强迫目标 \\\右方的参考注意产生黑色输入本身,而压制这种注意仍然让模型产生新的图像. 因此,我们希望的产出不是忘记而是复制。

blocks.en: This observation motivates CaD. For every target query, CaD drives target-to-reference attention mass toward one in a small set of early double-stream blocks. The objective has three useful consequences. First, attention normalization makes the reference compete directly with the text and target tokens, suppressing instruction following without needing to predict the future malicious prompt. Second, the objective is per token, preventing small identity regions from being washed out by an image-level average. Third, early-layer targeting makes the protection computationally efficient by construction. Once the last protected block is reached, we can truncate the forward pass at the last selected block and backpropagate only through this shallow set of layers, rather than differentiating through the billion-scale model. This shortened backpropagation path substantially reduces the cost of every optimization step.
blocks.zh: 这一观察激励了CaD. 对于每一个目标查询,CaD会将目标对参考的注意质量驱动到一组早期双流小块中的一个. 目标有三个有益的后果。 首先,注意力正常化使得参考物直接与文字和目标符号竞争,压制遵循指令而不需要预测未来的恶意提示. 第二,目标是每个标志,防止小的特征区域被图像水平平均值冲走。 第三,早期设定目标使保护通过建造得到计算效率。 一旦到达最后一个保护区块,我们就可以在最后一个选定的区块中截断前进通道,并且只能通过这组浅层,而不是通过十亿级模型加以区分。 这样缩短了反扩散路径,大大降低了每个优化步骤的成本.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: First , we identify two failures of attention-suppression defenses for multimodal DiT editors: mass redistribution , which leaves the text and target pathways free to render instruction-adjacent outputs similar to text-to-image generation with weak or no image conditioning, and token coverage , which makes image-averaged suppression poorly suited to full-body images. Second , through causal attention interventions, we show that the opposite direction is far more effective, i.e. , forcing early target-to-reference attention makes the editor copy its reference rather than edit it. Third , we introduce CaD, a per-token copy objective applied to early double-stream blocks. This placement is central to the method as it both induces copying and lets us truncate the model after the selected blocks, dramatically shortening the forward/backward path for each protection step. Lastly , we show that CaD substantially improves protection over existing baselines while retaining comparable imperceptibility and reducing protection time.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是: 首先,我们找出了多模式DiT编辑器的注意抑制防御的两个失败: 质量再分配 , 使文本和目标路径可以自由地提供与文本到图像生成相似的文本到图像生成, 并且没有图像条件, 以及象征性的覆盖 , 这使得图像平均压制不适合于全身图像。 第二,通过因果关注干预,我们显示相反的方向要有效得多,即强迫早期的目标参考关注让编辑复制其参考而不是编辑. 第三,我们引入CaD,一个适用于早期双流块的逐字复制目标. 这种放置是方法的核心,因为它既诱导复制,又让我们在选定块后缩短模型,大大缩短每个保护步骤的前向/后向路径. 最后,我们表明,CaD大大改善了对现有基线的保护,同时保持了类似的不易接受性并减少了保护时间。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Different harms motivate different protections. There are many ways an unauthorized image edit can be harmful, and consequently many ways researchers have tried to protect images from such edits. When the concern is misuse of a person’s identity or face, prior work has proposed protections against facial manipulation and personalized generation ( Le et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) . When the concern is artistic style mimicry, methods such as Glaze ( Shan et al., 2023 ) , Mist ( Liang & Wu, 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ) , and related approaches protect an artist’s work from being used to reproduce their style. Other methods target more general image manipulation, including inpainting and instruction-based editing ( Salman et al., 2023 ; Choi et al., 2025 ; Jeon et al., 2025 ) . In other words, “protecting an image” is not a single objective because what should be disrupted depends on what an attacker is trying to preserve, modify, or generate. At the same time, a growing body of work has questioned how much protection these methods provide outside the particular threat models for which they were designed ( Li et al., 2026 ; Hönig et al., 2025 ; Radiya-Dixit et al., 2021 ) . Protections that are effective against one manipulation may offer little protection against another, making broad claims of image protection difficult.
blocks.zh: 不同的伤害促使不同的保护。 未经授权的图像编辑可能有许多方式是有害的,因此许多研究者试图保护图像不受这种编辑的影响. 当人们担心滥用个人身份或脸部时,先前的工作曾建议保护人们免遭面部操纵和个性化生成(Le等人,2023年;Liu等人,2024年)。 当关注的是艺术风格模仿时,Glaze(Shan等人,2023年),Mist(Liang & Wu,2023年;Zheng等人,2025年)等方法和相关方法保护艺术家的作品不会被用于复制其风格. 其他方法针对的是更普遍的图像操纵,包括以印刷和教学为基础的编辑(Salman等人,2023年;Choi等人,2025年;Jeon等人,2025年)。 换句话说,“保护图像”并不是一个单一的目标,因为应该破坏的目标取决于攻击者试图保存、修改或生成什么。 同时,越来越多的工作质疑这些方法在所设计的特定威胁模型之外提供了多少保护(Li等人,2026年;Hönig等人,2025年;Radiya-Dixit等人,2021年)。 防止一种操纵的有效保护可能不会提供防止另一种操纵的保护,使对图像保护的广泛主张变得困难。

blocks.en: Protection is a moving target. Two broader challenges make proactive protection particularly difficult. First, generative models continue to evolve. A protection designed around one model family may no longer target the representations or mechanisms used by its successors, requiring defenses to evolve alongside the models they are intended to protect. Second, adversarial perturbations are inherently vulnerable to transformations of the protected image. Even ordinary processing, such as JPEG compression, resizing, or added noise, can weaken a perturbation, while an adversary can intentionally apply more sophisticated purification procedures designed to remove it ( Hönig et al., 2025 ) . These limitations do not eliminate the value of proactive protection, but they make it important to be precise about both the model and the manipulation against which a defense is evaluated.
blocks.zh: 保护是一个移动的目标。 两项更广泛的挑战使主动保护特别困难。 第一,基因模型继续演变。 围绕一个模范家庭设计的保护可能不再针对其继承人使用的陈述或机制,要求辩护方与它们打算保护的模式一起发展。 第二,对抗性扰动在本质上易受受保护图像转变的影响。 甚至普通的处理,如JPEG压缩,再大小,或添加噪音,都能够削弱扰动,而对手则可以有意采用更复杂的净化程序来消除扰动(Hönig等人,2025年). 这些限制并没有抹去主动保护的价值,但是它们使得必须准确了解评估辩护的模型和操纵。

blocks.en: Protecting images from modern DiT editors. Recent image editors increasingly replace the UNet backbone used by earlier latent diffusion models with diffusion transformers (DiTs) and related multimodal transformer architectures ( Peebles & Xie, 2023 ; Esser et al., 2024 ) . Models such as FLUX.1 Kontext ( Black Forest Labs, 2025 ) , Step1X-Edit ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , and FIBO Edit ( Gutflaish et al., 2025 ) perform instruction-based editing by jointly processing the reference image, the text instruction, and the image being generated. To the best of our knowledge, DeContext ( Shen et al., 2025 ) is the only existing proactive protection method designed specifically around this new class of in-context DiT editors. This does not mean that earlier protection methods cannot be applied to newer editors. Rather, they were not designed specifically for their architecture.
blocks.zh: 从现代的DiT编辑器中保护图像. 近期的图像编辑器越来越多地用扩散变压器(DiTs)和相关的多式联运变压器架构(Peebles & Xie, 2023;Esser等人, 2024年)取代早先潜在扩散模型所使用的UNet主干线。 FLUX.1 Kontext(黑森林实验室,2025年),Step1X-Edit(Liu等人,2025年),FIBO Edit(Gutflaish等人,2025年)等模型通过联合处理参考图像,文本指令,图像生成来进行基于指令的编辑. 据我们所知,DeContext(Shen等人,2025年)是目前唯一专门围绕这一新类内文DiT编辑器设计的主动保护方法。 这并不意味着早期的保护方法不能适用于较新的编辑. 相反,它们不是专门为其建筑设计的。

blocks.en: We therefore evaluate representative approaches from several existing families after adapting them to FLUX.1 Kontext and FIBO Edit. PhotoGuard ( Salman et al., 2023 ) perturbs the image so that its latent under the model’s VAE matches that of a mid-gray image. DeContext ( Shen et al., 2025 ) minimizes the attention that the generated image’s tokens place on the reference image’s tokens; for FIBO Edit, which takes structured JSON prompts, a VLM is called once per edit instruction on the clean image to produce them. Diff-PGD proposed as a baseline ( Shen et al., 2025 ) maximizes the flow-matching error the model makes when reconstructing a clean edit from the perturbed reference image, where the clean edit for each instruction is generated once with the editor itself and cached; for FIBO Edit, each edit is generated from a VLM-produced JSON prompt, so this also requires one VLM call per instruction. Our method also operates on attention, but starts from a different observation about how reference information should be manipulated. Rather than suppressing the reference image, we ask whether the model can be made to rely on it more . This distinction motivates the analysis in Sections 3 – 5 .
blocks.zh: 因此,我们在根据FLUX.1 Kontext和FIBO Edit加以调整后,对几个现有家庭的代表性方法进行评估。 PhotoGuard(Salman 等人, 2023年)干扰了图像, DeContext (Shen et al., 2025) 将生成的图像的符牌在参考图像的符牌上的注意力最小化;对于FIBO Edit,它采用结构化的JSON 提示,每一次在清洁图像上的编辑指令都会调用一个VLM来制作它们. Diff-PGD作为基线(Shen et al.,2025)被提议,在从扰动的参考图像中重建一个干净的编辑时,模型产生的流量匹配错误最大化,其中每个指令的干净编辑都是与编辑器本身一起生成并缓存的;对于FIBO Edit,每个编辑都是通过一个VLM制作的JSON的提示生成的,因此这也需要每个指令一个VLM调用. 我们的方法也以注意力为中心,但从如何操纵参考信息的不同观点出发。 我们不禁要问, 这一区别促使对第3至第5节的分析。

blocks.en: 4 Rethinking Reference Attention
blocks.zh: 4 重新思考参考资料

blocks.en: 4.1 Why Suppressing Reference Attention Is Not Enough
blocks.zh: 4.1 为何仅仅禁止参考就不够

blocks.en: DeContext suppresses the average attention mass that target queries place on reference keys. We find that its effectiveness depends strongly on image composition. As shown in Fig. 1 , suppression can disrupt identity preservation for a tightly cropped face, yet still permit successful edits of a protected full-body subject.
blocks.zh: DeContext 压制目标查询在引用密钥上放置的平均注意力量. 我们认为,其效力在很大程度上取决于形象构成。 如图1所示,压制会干扰身份保护,以免脸部被收紧,但仍允许成功编辑受保护的全身主体。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Reference suppression is less reliable when the protected subject occupies fewer image tokens. We overlay the Flux Kontext image-token grid on the protected inputs. Orange outlines mark majority-subject tokens and the blue box marks face tokens. Suppression disrupts the face-centric edits in (a), while both requested edits remain successful on the full-body subject in (b).
blocks.zh: 图 1:当被保护对象占用的图像符号较少时,引用压制就不那么可靠. 我们在保护输入上覆盖 Flux Kontext 图像键网格 。 橙色轮廓标记多数主体标志和蓝盒标志面额标志. 压制会扰乱(a)中的以面部为中心的编辑,而两个请求的编辑在(b)中的全体主题上仍然成功.

blocks.en: A key reason is token coverage . In Flux Kontext, the VAE downsamples spatially by 8 × 8\times and its latents are packed into 2 × 2 2\times 2 patches, so a 512 × 512 512\times 512 image produces a 32 × 32 32\times 32 grid of 1024 image tokens, each corresponding to a 16 × 16 16\times 16 pixel region. In Fig. 1 (a), 944 of 1024 tokens (92%) belong primarily to the subject, so an image-averaged suppression objective necessarily acts on subject information. In Fig. 1 (b), only 322 tokens (31%) belong primarily to the person and just 7 × 7 = 49 7\times 7=49 tokens (4.8%) cover the face. This is representative of BodyBench more broadly as the face-and-body mask occupies only 28.45 % ± 6.06 % 28.45\%\pm 6.06\% of the image area on average. Thus, an objective averaged over all target–reference interactions can be driven down largely through background tokens while leaving comparatively few identity related interactions intact.
blocks.zh: 一个关键原因是象征性报道。 在Flux Kontext中,VAE的降标在空间上被8×8\time及其潜伏被打包成2×2 2\time2补丁,所以一个512×512 512\time512映像产生32×3232\time32的网格1024映像符,每个网格对应16×16 16\time 16像素区域. 在图1(a)中,1024个令牌中的944个(92%)主要属于主体,因此一个图像平均压制目标必然对主体信息产生影响。 在图1(b)中,只有322个记号(31%)主要属于个人,只有7×7=49 7\times 7=49个记号(4.8%)覆盖面部. 这是Bench更广泛的代表,因为面部和身体面具平均只占图像面积的28.45% ± 6.06% 28.45ppm 6.06%。 因此,对所有目标-参考互动的客观平均值可以主要通过背景符号来推低,而与身份相关的互动则相对较少。

blocks.en: Two additional properties make reference suppression an incomplete objective. First, attention mass is redistributed : by Eq. 3 , reducing reference attention necessarily reallocates mass to text and target keys. The editor can therefore remain strongly driven by the instruction and its evolving target representation even when grounding in the reference is weakened. Second, reference information can move between token groups . Recent analysis of FLUX.2 shows that text tokens absorb visual information from the reference within early blocks and can subsequently carry that information toward the output ( Ge et al., 2026 ) . Removing a direct target-to-reference interaction therefore does not imply that reference information has been removed from the computation.
blocks.zh: 另有两个属性使得引用压制是一个不完整的目标. 首先,注意力质量被重新分配:通过Eq. 3,减少引用注意力必然将质量重新分配给文本和目标密钥. 因此,编辑可以继续受到该指示的强大推动,即使在该参考文献的立足点被削弱时,其不断变化的目标表述也依然如此。 第二,参考信息可以在符号组之间移动。 最近对FLUX.2的分析表明,文本符号吸收了早期区块内参考文献中的视觉信息,随后可以将这些信息带向输出(Ge等人,2026年)。 因此,删除直接的目标与参考互动并不意味着从计算中删除了参考信息。

blocks.en: These observations suggest that the central question is not merely how much reference attention to manipulate, but in which direction . We perform a controlled intervention where everything is held fixed except whether target-to-reference attention is removed or concentrated onto the reference.
blocks.zh: 这些意见表明,中心问题不仅仅是对操纵的注意程度,而是在哪个方向。 我们进行控制下的干预,将一切固定下来,但目标参考的注意力是去掉还是集中在参考物上。

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate on InpaintGuardBench ( Choi et al., 2025 ) and BodyBench ( Li et al., 2026 ) . InpaintGuardBench contains real, face-centric portraits in which the subject typically occupies most of the frame. We retain only images with a clearly visible identity and exclude unsuitable examples such as side-profile images, leaving 20 images. BodyBench contains synthetic full-body photographs, each paired with 15 editing prompts spanning diverse redressing and scene-resetting edits. We randomly sample 30 BodyBench images. This gives 50 protected images per experimental configuration and, with 15 edits per image, 750 edited outputs per configuration. We evaluate the protections in terms of both effectiveness, perceptibility, and computational efficiency.
blocks.zh: 我们对InpaintGuard Bench(Choi等人,2025年)和Body Bench(Li等人,2026年)进行评估。 InpaintGuard Bench中包含真实的,以面部为中心的肖像,其中主体一般占据大部分帧. 我们只保留有明显可见特征的图像,排除了侧面图像等不合适的例子,留下20个图像. Body Bench包含合成的全体照片,每张照片配对时有15个编辑提示,横跨不同的纠正和场景重置编辑. 我们随机抽取了30张Bench照片 这使得每个实验配置有50个受保护的图像,每个图像有15个编辑,每个配置有750个编辑输出. 我们从有效性、可感知性和计算效率两方面评估保护。

blocks.en: We evaluate protection effectiveness using Edit Success Rate (ESR), PickScore, CLIP directional similarity (CLIP dir ), and ArcFace similarity. ESR is the fraction of edited outputs judged successful by Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025 ) , which jointly considers the original image, edited image, edit instruction, and intended edited description. An edit is successful only if it realizes the requested transformation while preserving unrelated content and identity and avoiding major visual artifacts. PickScore ( Kirstain et al., 2023 ) measures alignment between the edited image and a target caption describing the requested edit. CLIP dir ( Gal et al., 2022 ) measures whether the change from the original to the edited image follows the corresponding semantic change in text embedding space. ArcFace ( Deng et al., 2019 ) measures identity similarity between the faces in the original and edited images. Lower values indicate stronger protection for all four metrics. We measure protection perceptibility between the original image and protected image using LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) and PSNR, where lower LPIPS and higher PSNR indicate a less perceptible perturbation. We additionally report computational efficiency using the median time per optimization step, T S T_{S} in seconds, and the resulting optimization time per protection, T P T_{P} in minutes.
blocks.zh: 我们通过编辑成功率(ESR)、PickScore、CLIP方向相似性(CLIP dir)和ArcFace相似性来评估保护的有效性。 ESR是Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct(Bai等人,2025年)判断成功的编辑产出的一小部分,它联合考虑原始图像,编辑图像,编辑指令,以及打算编辑的描述. 编辑只有在实现所请求的转换同时保留不相关的内容和身份,并避免重大视觉文物的情况下才会成功. PickScore(Kirstain et al., 2023)测量编辑的图像与描述请求编辑的目标标题之间的对齐. CLIP dir (Gal et al., 2022) 测量从原始图像到编辑图像的变化是否遵循文本嵌入空间的相应语义变化. ArcFace (Deng et al., 2019) 测量原始图像和编辑图像中面孔的相似性. 数值较低表明,对所有四个衡量标准的保护更加有力。 我们用LPIPS(张等人,2018年)和PSNR来测量原始图像与保护图像之间的保护感知度,其中LPIPS较低和PSNR较高表示的感知度较低. 我们用每个优化步骤的中位时间 TS TQQS 以秒表示计算效率, 以及由此得到的每个保护的优化时间 TP TQQP 以分钟表示。

blocks.en: We evaluate on two instruction-based DiT editors, FLUX.1 Kontext-dev ( Black Forest Labs, 2025 ) and FIBO Edit ( Gutflaish et al., 2025 ) . We compare CaD against three representative proactive defenses: PhotoGuard ( Salman et al., 2023 ) , DeContext ( Shen et al., 2025 ) , and Diff-PGD ( Shen et al., 2025 ) . We adapt each baseline to the corresponding editor while preserving its original protection objective and use the editor-specific conditioning required by each model, including FIBO’s structured JSON prompts. All methods are evaluated at ϵ ∈ { 4 , 8 , 12 , 16 } / 255 \epsilon\in\{4,8,12,16\}/255 . Full objective definitions and model-specific implementation details are provided in the appendix.

Table 1 and Fig. 3 summarize our main results at ϵ = 12 / 255 \epsilon=12/255 . Across both editors, CaD strongly disrupts the requested edit without requiring larger perturbations than the other optimization-based defenses.
The clearest gains appear on Flux Kontext. On BodyBench, CaD reduces edit success to 5.1 % 5.1\% , compared with 24.9 % 24.9\% for DeContext and 44.2 % 44.2\% for Diff-PGD. CLIP dir falls to 0.0359 0.0359 , far below the next-best protected result of 0.2574 0.2574 . We see the same pattern on InpaintGuardBench, where CaD reaches 16.0 % 16.0\% edit success and a CLIP dir score of 0.0513 0.0513 . The qualitative examples in Fig. 3 match this behavior: while the baselines often still carry out the requested transformation, our protected outputs tend to remain close to the original input. We note the decontextualization behavior of DeContext in the third row of Fig. 3 where the identity of the original subject is not present in the edit, yet the unconditional generation (as if using a black reference) is still generated. Based on the intuition discussed in section 4 , we would still see to avoid this behavior.

The same advantage holds on FIBO, where CaD takes 0.754 0.754 s per step and 12.57 12.57 min per protection. Figure 5 further shows that the full optimization budget is often unnecessary: by 300 steps, CaD already outperforms the final 800-step baselines across all four protection metrics, corresponding to only about 3.2 3.2 minutes of optimization on Flux Kontext.

blocks.en: Block selection. Our intervention study suggests that the copying behavior is established early in the network. We therefore vary how many consecutive double-stream blocks are included in the protection objective. Figure 6 shows that optimizing only block 0 is weaker, while extending the objective through block 4 sharply decreases PickScore, CLIP dir , and edit success. Using additional layers may not continue to improve protection. Instead, we trade a small amount of protection strength for lower LPIPS. This supports using these shallower prefix rather than using the full transformer.

blocks.en: Objective direction. We finally isolate the direction of the attention objective. Both variants use the same double blocks, perturbation budget, and number of PGD steps; the only difference is whether target-to-reference attention is minimized or maximized. Minimizing reference attention barely changes edit success, from 81.6 % 81.6\% on the unprotected images to 80.7 % 80.7\% . Maximizing the same attention instead reduces edit success to 5.1 % 5.1\% , while also producing much larger drops in PickScore and CLIP dir . This matches the intervention result from Section 4 . The important choice is not simply to manipulate reference attention, but to increase it enough to push the model toward copying.
blocks.zh: 客观方向. 我们最终孤立了关注目标的方向。 两种变式都使用相同的双块,扰动预算和PGD步骤的数量;唯一的区别是目标参考注意力是最小化还是最大化. 最小化参考关注几乎不会改变编辑成功率,从无保护图像的81.6%、81.6 % 到80.7%、80.7 % 。 最大程度的相同关注将编辑成功率降低到5.1%、5.1 % , 同时在PickScore和CLIP dir 中也产生了更大的下降。 这符合第4节的干预结果。 重要的选择不仅仅是操控参考关注,而是要增加足够的参考关注,将模型推向复制.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: Modern in-context image editors make heavy use of the reference image, so existing defenses have naturally tried to protect that image by making the model attend to it less. We find that this is often the wrong direction. Suppressing reference attention can leave the model free to follow the instruction, particularly when the protected subject occupies only a small fraction of the image. Controlled interventions reveal a different behavior when reference attention is increased. Once target tokens are made to rely strongly on the reference in the early transformer blocks, the model begins to reproduce the input instead of editing it. We turn this observation into CaD, a protection objective that increases target-to-reference attention for each target token in a small set of early blocks. Across FLUX Kontext and FIBO Edit, CaD provides stronger protection than existing baselines while maintaining comparable perturbation quality, and its early-layer objective makes optimization considerably cheaper. Our results suggest that protecting images from modern editors need not mean hiding the reference from the model. Making the model rely on it more can itself be a defense.
blocks.zh: 现代的内装文本图像编辑器大量使用参考图像,因此现有的防御系统自然试图通过让模型较少关注来保护该图像. 我们认为,这往往是错误的方向。 压制参考注意可以让模型自由遵循指示,特别是在被保护对象只占据图像的一小部分时. 受控干预显示,当参考注意力增加时,行为不同. 一旦目标符号在早期变压器块中强烈依赖引用,模型开始复制输入而不是编辑. 我们把这个观察变成CaD,这个保护目标在一小组早期的块中,会增加每个目标符的靶向参照关注. 在整个FLUX Kontext和FIBO Edit中,CaD提供了比现有基线更强大的保护,同时保持可比的扰动质量,它的早期目标使得优化更便宜. 我们的结果显示,保护图像不受现代编辑的影响,并不意味着从模型中隐藏参考。 让模型更加依赖它本身就能够成为防御.

blocks.en: Limitations. Our evaluation is limited to two DiT-based editors. Like other optimization-based proactive defenses, CaD also assumes white-box access to the protected editor during perturbation construction and requires per-image optimization, despite being substantially cheaper than deeper attention- or denoiser-based objectives. Finally, adversarial image protections can be weakened by common transformations such as compression, resizing, or noise, and by deliberate purification procedures; we do not evaluate robustness against such adaptive preprocessing or attacks here.
blocks.zh: 限制。 我们的评价仅限于两位基于DiT的编辑. 和其他基于优化的主动防御一样,CaD也假设在扰动构造中白箱访问受保护的编辑器,并且需要每个图像优化,尽管比更深层的注意力-或denoiser-目标要便宜得多. 最后,对抗性图像保护可能因压缩、再生大小或噪音等常见转变以及故意的净化程序而削弱;我们不评估这种适应性预处理或攻击的强度。
